title: Out-of-Bounds Read and Incorrect IV Length Handling in AES-GCM-SIV
description: CVE-2026-95692 is a vulnerability in Microsoft product version 3.0 involving an out-of-bounds read and incorrect initialization vector (IV) length handling in AES-GCM-SIV encryption. The issue is categorized under CWE-125 (out-of-bounds read). No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided, and no patch or remediation details are available.
